description: How a reported figure is built, from the filing itself: the lines the company's own XBRL calculation adds up to it, each line's value, every sum recomputed and checked, what the figure feeds into, and how the filing splits it by segment, product or region. It shows the filing agrees with itself, not that the figures are right.

measure.description: revenue, net_income, operating_income, gross_profit, cost_of_revenue, operating_expenses, pretax_income, total_assets, current_assets, total_liabilities, current_liabilities, equity, operating_cash_flow, or any tag the filing uses (NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivities, or us-gaap:Assets).

year.description: The calendar year the report's period ends in. Default the latest filed.

name: figure_trace

outputSchema.description: tree is the figure with its children, each line's value and weight, and check on each sum.
